title: Pluriversal technologies: A decolonial typology of knowledge integration for disruptive sustainability
why: A decolonial typology of how knowledge gets integrated is the most usable thing the radar has turned up for the Santos strand of your CARN workshop, and it gives you language for deciding who counts as a knowledge partner in Digital Twin Flevoland.
